senses.label: amount or stage
senses.definitionEn: the amount, height or stage that something has reached

examples.en: My English is at an intermediate level now.
The water level in the river rose after the storm.
examples.tr: Fırtınadan sonra nehirdeki su seviyesi yükseldi.

examples.en: This game has twenty levels, and I'm stuck on the fifth.
examples.tr: Bu oyunun yirmi bölümü var ve ben beşincide takıldım.

commonMistakesTr: "allow" fiilinden sonra "to" gelir: "allow me go" değil, "allow me to go" denir.

senses.label: give permission
senses.definitionEn: to let someone do something or let something happen

examples.en: My parents didn't allow me to stay out late.
examples.tr: Ailem geç saate kadar dışarıda kalmama izin vermedi.

examples.en: Are we allowed to use a dictionary in the exam?
examples.tr: Sınavda sözlük kullanmamıza izin var mı?

examples.en: The company allows employees to work from home on Fridays.
examples.tr: Şirket çalışanların cuma günleri evden çalışmasına izin veriyor.

grammarNoteTr: add A to B: A'yı B'ye eklemek

senses.label: put with something else
senses.definitionEn: to put something together with something else so that it becomes bigger or different

examples.en: Add a little salt to the soup.
I added your name to the guest list.
If you add five and seven, you get twelve.
examples.tr: Beş ile yediyi toplarsan on iki eder.

senses.label: place of work
senses.definitionEn: a room or building where people work at desks

examples.en: I usually get to the office at nine.
examples.noteTr: get to the office: ofise varmak.

examples.en: Our office is on the third floor.
Is the post office open on Saturdays?

senses.label: entrance
senses.definitionEn: the part of a building, room or car that you open to go in or out

examples.en: Please close the door when you leave.
Someone is knocking at the door.
Our neighbors next door have a big dog.
examples.tr: Yan komşularımızın büyük bir köpeği var.
examples.noteTr: next door: yan taraf, yan ev.

commonMistakesTr: "health" isimdir; sıfat olarak "healthy" kullanılır: "health food" ama "a healthy person".

senses.label: condition of the body
senses.definitionEn: the condition of your body and mind

examples.en: Smoking is bad for your health.
examples.noteTr: be bad for: ... için zararlı olmak.

examples.en: My grandfather is ninety and still in good health.
examples.tr: Dedem doksan yaşında ve hâlâ sağlığı yerinde.

examples.en: The school offers free health checks for students.
examples.tr: Okul öğrencilere ücretsiz sağlık kontrolü sunuyor.

commonMistakesTr: "person" kelimesinin çoğulu genellikle "people"dır; "persons" çok resmîdir.

senses.label: human being
senses.definitionEn: a man, woman or child

examples.en: She is the kindest person I know.
examples.noteTr: the + -est + person I know: tanıdığım en ... kişi.

examples.en: The tickets cost twenty dollars per person.
I'd rather talk about this in person.
examples.tr: Bunu yüz yüze konuşmayı tercih ederim.

senses.label: painting, drawing etc.
senses.definitionEn: paintings, drawings and other things people make to be beautiful or express ideas

examples.en: We visited an art museum in the city center.
examples.tr: Şehir merkezindeki bir sanat müzesini gezdik.

examples.en: Art was my favorite subject at school.
Cooking is a real art in her family.
examples.tr: Onun ailesinde yemek yapmak gerçek bir sanattır.

grammarNoteTr: be sure (that) + cümle / be sure about + isim

senses.label: certain
senses.definitionEn: having no doubt that something is true or correct

examples.en: Are you sure you locked the door?
Make sure you take an umbrella today.
examples.noteTr: make sure: mutlaka ... yapmak, emin olmak.

examples.en: I'm not sure what time the movie starts.
examples.tr: Filmin saat kaçta başladığından emin değilim.

senses.label: yes, of course
senses.definitionEn: used in speech to say yes politely

examples.en: Sure, you can borrow my pen for a minute.
examples.tr: Tabii, kalemimi bir dakikalığına ödünç alabilirsin.

examples.en: Sure, I can help you move on Saturday.

senses.label: fighting between countries
senses.definitionEn: a period of fighting between countries or large groups of people

examples.en: Many cities were destroyed during the war.
My great-grandfather never talked about the war.
The two countries were at war for ten years.
examples.tr: İki ülke on yıl boyunca savaş halindeydi.
examples.noteTr: be at war: savaş halinde olmak.

commonMistakesTr: "history" geçmiş/tarih demektir; bir hikâye için "story" kullanılır.

senses.label: the past
senses.definitionEn: the study of past events, or all the events of the past

examples.en: I'm reading a book about the history of Istanbul.
examples.tr: İstanbul'un tarihi hakkında bir kitap okuyorum.

examples.en: History was always my best subject.
examples.tr: Tarih her zaman en iyi dersimdi.

examples.en: This was the biggest storm in the town's history.
examples.tr: Bu, kasabanın tarihindeki en büyük fırtınaydı.

grammarNoteTr: have / throw a party: parti vermek

senses.label: social event
senses.definitionEn: an event where people meet to eat, drink, talk and have fun

examples.en: We're having a party for Ali's birthday.
examples.tr: Ali'nin doğum günü için parti veriyoruz.

examples.en: Did you enjoy the party last night?
The office party ended at midnight.

senses.label: political group
senses.definitionEn: an organized group of people with the same political aims

examples.en: Each party chose a new leader this year.
examples.tr: Her parti bu yıl yeni bir lider seçti.

examples.en: She has been a member of a party since university.

commonMistakesTr: "within two days" iki gün içinde (en geç) demektir; "in two days" ise iki gün sonra anlamına gelir.

senses.label: before the end of / inside
senses.definitionEn: before a period of time has passed, or inside a place or group

examples.en: Please reply within three days.
examples.tr: Lütfen üç gün içinde cevap verin.

examples.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the beach.
There were some problems within the team.

senses.label: become bigger
senses.definitionEn: to become bigger or taller, or to make plants develop

examples.en: Children grow so fast at this age.
examples.tr: Çocuklar bu yaşta çok hızlı büyüyor.

examples.en: My grandmother grows tomatoes in her garden.
I grew up in a small village near the sea.
examples.tr: Deniz kenarında küçük bir köyde büyüdüm.

senses.label: outcome
senses.definitionEn: something that happens because of something else, or the final score or mark

examples.en: We'll get our exam results next week.
It rained all day, and as a result the match was cancelled.
examples.tr: Bütün gün yağmur yağdı ve sonuç olarak maç iptal edildi.

examples.en: The final result was a draw.

grammarNoteTr: fiil ve sıfat olarak kullanılır: open the door / The shop is open.

senses.label: make not closed
senses.definitionEn: to move something so that it is no longer closed, or to start working for the public

examples.en: Could you open the window, please?
The new café opens at seven in the morning.
She opened the letter with shaking hands.

commonMistakesTr: "in the morning" denir ama belirli bir gün için "on Monday morning" kullanılır.
grammarNoteTr: in the morning / on Monday morning

senses.label: early part of the day
senses.definitionEn: the part of the day from when the sun rises until twelve o'clock

examples.en: I drink coffee every morning.
Good morning! Did you sleep well?
I have a meeting on Monday morning.

grammarNoteTr: go for a walk: yürüyüşe çıkmak

senses.label: move on foot
senses.definitionEn: to move along by putting one foot in front of the other

examples.en: I walk to work when the weather is nice.
examples.tr: Hava güzel olduğunda işe yürüyerek giderim.

examples.en: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
examples.noteTr: Burada isim: go for a walk.

examples.en: He walked the dog twice yesterday.

commonMistakesTr: "the reason of" değil, "the reason for" denir.
grammarNoteTr: the reason for + isim / the reason why + cümle

senses.label: why something happens
senses.definitionEn: a fact or situation that explains why something happens

examples.en: What's the reason for the delay?
For some reason, my phone won't charge.
There's no reason to be afraid.

senses.label: not high
senses.definitionEn: not high, or below the usual amount or level

examples.en: Prices are very low in this market.
Be careful, the ceiling is low here.
She spoke in a low voice so the baby wouldn't wake up.
examples.tr: Bebek uyanmasın diye alçak sesle konuştu.

commonMistakesTr: "win" bir oyunu/ödülü kazanmak; para kazanmak için "earn" kullanılır.

senses.label: be the best in a game
senses.definitionEn: to be the best or first in a game, race or competition

examples.en: Our team won the match three to one.
Who do you think will win the race?
She has won two prizes for her photos.

commonMistakesTr: "research" sayılamaz: "a research" veya "researches" değil, "some research" ya da "a study" denir.
grammarNoteTr: sayılamaz isim; do research on + konu

senses.label: detailed study
senses.definitionEn: careful study of a subject to discover new facts

examples.en: She is doing research on sleep and memory.
examples.tr: Uyku ve hafıza üzerine araştırma yapıyor.
examples.noteTr: do research on: ... üzerine araştırma yapmak.

examples.en: I did some research before buying a new laptop.
examples.tr: Yeni dizüstü bilgisayar almadan önce biraz araştırma yaptım.

examples.en: New research shows that walking improves mood.
examples.tr: Yeni araştırmalar yürümenin ruh halini iyileştirdiğini gösteriyor.

senses.label: female child
senses.definitionEn: a female child or young woman

examples.en: A little girl was playing in the park.
examples.noteTr: a little girl: küçük bir kız.

examples.en: They have two boys and a girl.
examples.tr: İki oğulları ve bir kızları var.

examples.en: The girls in my class all love basketball.

senses.label: man (informal)
senses.definitionEn: an informal word for a man

examples.en: Who's that guy talking to your sister?
examples.tr: Kız kardeşinle konuşan şu adam kim?

examples.en: He's a really nice guy once you get to know him.
examples.tr: Onu tanıyınca gerçekten iyi bir adam.

examples.en: Hey guys, are we still meeting at eight?
examples.tr: Selam millet, hâlâ sekizde buluşuyor muyuz?
examples.noteTr: you guys / hey guys: bir gruba seslenirken, kadın-erkek fark etmez.

senses.label: things you eat
senses.definitionEn: things that people and animals eat

examples.en: I really love spicy food from the south.
examples.tr: Güneyin acı yemeklerini gerçekten çok severim.

examples.en: Is there any food left in the fridge?
We don't eat fast food very often.

senses.label: very short time
senses.definitionEn: a very short period of time, or a particular point in time

examples.en: Just a moment, I'll get my keys.
examples.noteTr: just a moment: bir saniye/bir dakika.

examples.en: She's busy at the moment, can you call back later?
examples.tr: Şu anda meşgul, daha sonra tekrar arayabilir misin?

examples.en: That was the happiest moment of my life.

commonMistakesTr: Özne "he" ise dönüşlü zamir "himself" olur; "hisself" diye bir kelime yoktur.

senses.label: reflexive / emphasis
senses.definitionEn: used when the man or boy who does an action is also the one it affects, or for emphasis

examples.en: He cut himself while cooking dinner.
examples.noteTr: Dönüşlü: eylemi yapan ve etkilenen aynı kişi.

examples.en: My little brother can dress himself now.
examples.tr: Küçük kardeşim artık kendi kendine giyinebiliyor.

examples.en: He built the whole house by himself.
examples.tr: Bütün evi tek başına inşa etti.

senses.label: gas we breathe
senses.definitionEn: the mixture of gases around the earth that we breathe

examples.en: Let's open the window and get some fresh air.
examples.tr: Pencereyi açıp biraz temiz hava alalım.

examples.en: The air in big cities is often dirty.
examples.tr: Büyük şehirlerde hava çoğu zaman kirli.

examples.en: Most of our products are sent by air.

commonMistakesTr: İngilizcede öğretmene "Teacher!" diye seslenmek doğal değildir; "Mr. / Ms. + soyadı" kullanılır.

senses.label: person who teaches
senses.definitionEn: a person whose job is to help people learn, especially in a school

examples.en: My English teacher gives us homework every day.
examples.tr: İngilizce öğretmenim bize her gün ödev veriyor.

examples.en: Her mother is a primary school teacher.
examples.noteTr: Meslek söylerken 'a' kullanılır: She is a teacher.

examples.en: Did the teacher say the test is on Friday?
examples.tr: Öğretmen sınavın cuma olduğunu mu söyledi?

senses.label: make someone do something
senses.definitionEn: to make someone do something they do not want to do

examples.en: The rain forced us to stay inside all day.
examples.tr: Yağmur bizi bütün gün içeride kalmaya zorladı.

examples.en: Nobody can force you to sign the contract.
The factory was forced to close last year.
examples.tr: Fabrika geçen yıl kapanmak zorunda kaldı.

commonMistakesTr: Sıfattan sonra gelir: "enough big" değil, "big enough".

senses.label: as much as needed
senses.definitionEn: as much or as many as you need

examples.en: We don't have enough chairs for everyone.
Is this bag big enough for all your books?
examples.tr: Bu çanta bütün kitapların için yeterince büyük mü?

examples.en: Stop it, I've had enough!

senses.label: teaching and learning
senses.definitionEn: the process of teaching and learning, usually at a school or university

examples.en: Education should be free for every child.
examples.tr: Eğitim her çocuk için ücretsiz olmalı.

examples.en: He finished his education in Germany.
The government plans to spend more on education.
examples.tr: Hükümet eğitime daha fazla harcama yapmayı planlıyor.

commonMistakesTr: "across" bir yüzeyin bir tarafından öbürüne geçmek; "through" ise bir şeyin içinden geçmek demektir.

senses.label: from one side to the other
senses.definitionEn: from one side of something to the other, or on the other side

examples.en: We walked across the bridge to the old town.
The bank is just across the street.
The company has stores across the country.
examples.tr: Şirketin ülkenin her yerinde mağazaları var.

commonMistakesTr: Çoğulu düzensizdir: "foots" değil, "feet".

senses.label: part of the body
senses.definitionEn: the part of your body at the end of your leg that you stand on

examples.en: I hurt my foot playing football.
My feet are cold, where are my socks?
It takes ten minutes to get there on foot.
examples.tr: Oraya yürüyerek gitmek on dakika sürüyor.

senses.label: number two in order
senses.definitionEn: coming after the first in order

examples.en: This is my second visit to Ankara.
Our apartment is on the second floor.
She finished second in the race.

senses.label: unit of time
senses.definitionEn: a very short unit of time; sixty of them make one minute

examples.en: The microwave beeped after thirty seconds.
Wait a second, I can't find my phone.

senses.label: male child
senses.definitionEn: a male child or young man

examples.en: The boy next door plays the drums every evening.
examples.tr: Yan evdeki oğlan her akşam davul çalıyor.

examples.en: When I was a boy, I wanted to be a pilot.
examples.noteTr: When I was a boy: çocukken.

examples.en: Their baby is a boy, and they named him Can.
examples.tr: Bebekleri erkek ve adını Can koydular.

commonMistakesTr: "maybe" (belki) tek kelimedir; "may be" ayrı yazılınca "olabilir" anlamında fiildir.

senses.label: possibly
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something is possible but not certain

examples.en: Maybe we can go to the beach tomorrow.
Maybe you're right, I should call her.
I might come tonight, maybe after nine.
examples.tr: Bu akşam gelebilirim, belki dokuzdan sonra.

senses.label: in the direction of
senses.definitionEn: in the direction of something, or near a time

examples.en: The dog ran toward me, wagging its tail.
examples.tr: Köpek kuyruğunu sallayarak bana doğru koştu.

examples.en: It usually gets colder toward the end of October.
examples.tr: Ekim sonuna doğru hava genelde soğur.

examples.en: His attitude toward work has changed a lot.

commonMistakesTr: "can" geleceğe ya da "have" yapılarına girmez; bu durumlarda "will be able to" veya "have been able to" kullanılır.

senses.label: can do something
senses.definitionEn: having the skill, power or chance to do something

examples.en: Will you be able to come to my party?
I wasn't able to sleep because of the noise.
After a month, she was able to speak basic Spanish.
examples.tr: Bir ay sonra temel düzeyde İspanyolca konuşabiliyordu.

commonMistakesTr: Yaş sorarken "What is your age?" yerine genelde "How old are you?" denir.

senses.label: how old someone is
senses.definitionEn: the number of years someone has lived or something has existed

examples.en: She started playing the piano at the age of five.
We're the same age, but he looks much older.
examples.tr: Aynı yaştayız ama o çok daha yaşlı görünüyor.

examples.en: People in this town live to a great age.
examples.tr: Bu kasabadaki insanlar çok uzun yaşıyor.

commonMistakesTr: "everything" tekil fiil alır: "Everything are ready" değil, "Everything is ready".

senses.label: all things
senses.definitionEn: all things, or all the things in a situation

examples.en: Everything is ready for the trip.
Thanks for everything you did for me.
examples.tr: Benim için yaptığın her şey için teşekkürler.

examples.en: Did you remember everything on the shopping list?
examples.tr: Alışveriş listesindeki her şeyi hatırladın mı?

senses.label: like very much / care deeply
senses.definitionEn: to have very strong warm feelings for someone, or to like something very much

examples.en: I love you more than anything.
My kids love swimming in the sea.
I'd love to come, but I have to work.
examples.tr: Gelmeyi çok isterdim ama çalışmam lazım.

senses.label: series of actions
senses.definitionEn: a series of actions or changes that happen to reach a result

examples.en: Learning a language is a slow process.
The application process takes about two weeks.
examples.tr: Başvuru süreci yaklaşık iki hafta sürüyor.

examples.en: We're in the process of moving to a new flat.

commonMistakesTr: "music" sayılamaz: "a music" değil, "a song" veya "a piece of music" denir.

senses.label: sounds as art
senses.definitionEn: sounds arranged in a pleasant way, made by voices or instruments

examples.en: I listen to music on the bus every day.
What kind of music do you like?
The music at the wedding was too loud.

senses.label: as part of a group
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something is part of a group or total

examples.en: The meal cost forty dollars, including drinks.
examples.tr: Yemek, içecekler dahil kırk dolar tuttu.

examples.en: Ten people came, including my old teacher.
examples.tr: Eski öğretmenim de dahil on kişi geldi.

examples.en: The price is fifty euros, not including delivery.

senses.label: start to be seen / seem
senses.definitionEn: to start to be seen, or to seem to be something

examples.en: A cat suddenly appeared from under the car.
examples.tr: Arabanın altından aniden bir kedi çıktı.

examples.en: He appears to be very tired today.
Her photo appeared in the local newspaper.

commonMistakesTr: "actually" "aslında" demektir, "şu anda" (aktüel) değil; "şu anda" için "currently" kullanılır.

senses.label: in fact
senses.definitionEn: used to say what is really true, often when it is surprising

examples.en: He looks serious, but he's actually very funny.
examples.tr: Ciddi görünüyor ama aslında çok komik.

examples.en: Actually, I'd prefer tea instead of coffee.
examples.tr: Aslında kahve yerine çay tercih ederim.

examples.en: Did you actually read the whole book?

senses.label: pay money for
senses.definitionEn: to get something by paying money for it

examples.en: I need to buy a new phone.
She bought me a book for my birthday.
examples.tr: Doğum günüm için bana bir kitap aldı.

examples.en: Where did you buy that jacket?

senses.label: very likely
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something is very likely to happen or be true

examples.en: It will probably rain this afternoon.
examples.tr: Bu öğleden sonra muhtemelen yağmur yağacak.

examples.en: She's probably still at work.
I probably won't finish the report today.

commonMistakesTr: "human" ile "humane" farklıdır: "humane" insancıl, merhametli demektir.

senses.label: of people
senses.definitionEn: relating to people rather than animals or machines

examples.en: The human body is mostly water.
It was a human mistake, not a computer error.
Don't be so hard on yourself, you're only human.
examples.tr: Kendine bu kadar yüklenme, sen de insansın.
examples.noteTr: You're only human: sen de insansın, hata yapabilirsin.

grammarNoteTr: serve as + isim: ... olarak hizmet etmek

senses.label: give food / help customers
senses.definitionEn: to give people food or drinks, or to help customers in a shop or restaurant

examples.en: Breakfast is served from seven to ten.
examples.tr: Kahvaltı yediden ona kadar servis ediliyor.

examples.en: The waiter who served us was very friendly.
examples.tr: Bize hizmet eden garson çok güler yüzlüydü.

examples.en: Serve the soup hot with some fresh bread.
examples.tr: Çorbayı biraz taze ekmekle sıcak servis edin.

senses.label: place to buy and sell
senses.definitionEn: a place where people buy and sell goods, or the business of buying and selling

examples.en: We buy fresh vegetables at the market every Sunday.
examples.tr: Her pazar pazardan taze sebze alırız.

examples.en: The job market is difficult for young people now.
examples.tr: İş piyasası şu an gençler için zor.

examples.en: This phone is the cheapest one on the market.
examples.tr: Bu telefon piyasadaki en ucuz telefon.

commonMistakesTr: "die" fiildir, "dead" sıfattır: "He is die" değil, "He is dead" veya "He died" denir.

senses.label: stop living
senses.definitionEn: to stop living

examples.en: My plants died while I was on holiday.
Her grandfather died at the age of ninety-two.
I'm dying to see the new movie.
examples.tr: Yeni filmi görmek için can atıyorum.
examples.noteTr: be dying to: ... için can atmak.

senses.label: make something go somewhere
senses.definitionEn: to make a message, letter or thing go to someone

examples.en: Can you send me the photos from the trip?
I sent the report to my manager this morning.
They send their kids to a school near the park.
examples.tr: Çocuklarını parkın yakınındaki bir okula gönderiyorlar.

grammarNoteTr: make sense: mantıklı olmak, anlaşılır olmak

senses.label: feeling / meaning
senses.definitionEn: a feeling or understanding of something, or one of the natural abilities like sight or hearing

examples.en: Your idea doesn't make sense to me.
She has a great sense of humor.
Dogs have a very strong sense of smell.
examples.tr: Köpeklerin koku alma duyusu çok güçlüdür.

senses.label: make by putting parts together
senses.definitionEn: to make a building or other structure by putting materials together

examples.en: They're building a new hospital near our house.
examples.tr: Evimizin yakınına yeni bir hastane yapıyorlar.

examples.en: This bridge was built more than a hundred years ago.
examples.tr: Bu köprü yüz yıldan daha uzun süre önce inşa edildi.

examples.en: It takes time to build trust in a new team.
examples.tr: Yeni bir ekipte güven oluşturmak zaman alır.

grammarNoteTr: stay at + yer / stay up: geç saate kadar yatmamak

senses.label: not leave / live for a short time
senses.definitionEn: to continue to be in a place, or to live somewhere for a short time

examples.en: I'm going to stay at home tonight.
We stayed at a small hotel by the sea.
examples.tr: Deniz kenarında küçük bir otelde kaldık.
examples.noteTr: stay at a hotel: otelde kalmak.

examples.en: Don't stay up too late, you have school tomorrow.
examples.tr: Çok geç yatma, yarın okulun var.
examples.noteTr: stay up: geç saate kadar uyumamak.

senses.label: go down to the ground
senses.definitionEn: to go down quickly from a higher place to a lower place

examples.en: Be careful, you might fall on the ice.
The baby fell asleep in the car.
Prices have fallen a lot this month.

senses.label: expressing surprise or feeling
senses.definitionEn: a sound you make to show surprise, understanding, or disappointment

examples.en: Oh no, I left my wallet at home!
Oh, I didn't know you had a sister.
Oh well, we can try again next week.

senses.label: country and its people
senses.definitionEn: a country, or all the people who live in it

examples.en: The whole nation watched the final match.
Leaders from many nations met in Geneva.
examples.tr: Birçok ülkeden liderler Cenevre'de bir araya geldi.

examples.en: It is one of the smallest nations in Europe.

senses.label: intention / arrangement
senses.definitionEn: something you have decided to do and how you will do it

examples.en: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
examples.tr: Hafta sonu için planın var mı?

examples.en: We need a better plan to save money.
examples.tr: Para biriktirmek için daha iyi bir plana ihtiyacımız var.

examples.en: Change of plan, we're meeting at the café instead.
examples.tr: Plan değişti, onun yerine kafede buluşuyoruz.

senses.label: divide with a knife / reduce
senses.definitionEn: to use a knife or scissors to divide something, or to make an amount smaller

examples.en: Can you cut the cake into eight pieces?
I cut my finger while I was opening the box.
examples.noteTr: cut - cut - cut: üç hali aynı.

examples.en: The company plans to cut costs next year.
examples.tr: Şirket gelecek yıl maliyetleri azaltmayı planlıyor.

commonMistakesTr: Amerikan İngilizcesinde "college" genellikle üniversite demektir, Türkiye'deki 'kolej' (özel lise) değildir.

senses.label: higher education
senses.definitionEn: a place where people study after high school

examples.en: My brother is in his second year of college.
What did you study in college?
She wants to go to college in another city.
examples.tr: Başka bir şehirde üniversiteye gitmek istiyor.

commonMistakesTr: "interest to" değil, "interest in" denir.

senses.label: wanting to know more
senses.definitionEn: the feeling of wanting to know more about something or to give it attention

examples.en: He has a strong interest in old cars.
The kids quickly lost interest in the game.
Reading and hiking are my main interests.
examples.tr: Okumak ve doğa yürüyüşü başlıca ilgi alanlarım.

senses.label: money paid on a loan
senses.definitionEn: extra money you pay when you borrow money, or get when you save it

examples.en: The bank charges high interest on this loan.
examples.tr: Banka bu kredi için yüksek faiz alıyor.

examples.en: Interest rates went up again this month.
examples.tr: Faiz oranları bu ay yine yükseldi.

commonMistakesTr: "death" isimdir (ölüm); sıfat "dead", fiil "die"dır.

senses.label: end of life
senses.definitionEn: the end of a life

examples.en: His death was a shock to the whole village.
examples.tr: Ölümü bütün köy için bir şoktu.

examples.en: After the death of her father, she took over the shop.
examples.noteTr: after the death of: ...nin ölümünden sonra.

examples.en: I was bored to death during that lecture.

senses.label: set of lessons
senses.definitionEn: a set of lessons or classes on a subject

examples.en: I'm taking an online course in photography.
examples.tr: Fotoğrafçılık üzerine çevrimiçi bir kursa gidiyorum.

examples.en: The course lasts twelve weeks.
Of course I can help you, what do you need?
examples.tr: Tabii ki sana yardım edebilirim, neye ihtiyacın var?

grammarNoteTr: tekil fiil alır; soru ve olumsuzda genelde anyone

senses.label: a person
senses.definitionEn: a person, when you do not know or say who

examples.en: Someone left an umbrella on the bus.
I think someone is following us.
You should talk to someone about this problem.

commonMistakesTr: İş tecrübesi anlamında sayılamaz: "experiences" değil, "experience"; ama yaşanan olay anlamında sayılabilir.

senses.label: knowledge from doing / event
senses.definitionEn: knowledge or skill you get from doing something, or something that happens to you

examples.en: Do you have any experience with children?
examples.tr: Çocuklarla ilgili herhangi bir deneyimin var mı?

examples.en: She has ten years of experience as a nurse.
examples.tr: Hemşire olarak on yıllık tecrübesi var.

examples.en: Living abroad was an amazing experience.
examples.tr: Yurt dışında yaşamak harika bir deneyimdi.

senses.label: at the back of
senses.definitionEn: at or to the back of something or someone

examples.en: The car park is behind the supermarket.
Who's that standing behind you in the photo?
I was ill for a week and fell behind with my work.
examples.tr: Bir hafta hastaydım ve işlerimde geride kaldım.

commonMistakesTr: "reach" edat almaz: "reach to the city" değil, "reach the city" denir.

senses.label: arrive / stretch to
senses.definitionEn: to arrive at a place, or to stretch your arm to touch something

examples.en: We reached the hotel just before midnight.
examples.tr: Otele gece yarısından hemen önce vardık.

examples.en: I can't reach the top shelf without a chair.
examples.tr: Sandalye olmadan en üst rafa uzanamıyorum.

examples.en: I tried to reach you by phone all day.
examples.tr: Bütün gün sana telefonla ulaşmaya çalıştım.

senses.label: cause to die
senses.definitionEn: to make a person, animal or plant die

examples.en: The cold weather killed all the flowers in the garden.
examples.tr: Soğuk hava bahçedeki bütün çiçekleri öldürdü.

examples.en: Three people were killed in the accident.
We played cards to kill time at the airport.
examples.tr: Havalimanında vakit öldürmek için kâğıt oynadık.

senses.label: number 6
senses.definitionEn: the number 6

examples.en: I get up at six every morning.
We have six people in our team.
She has lived in Izmir for six years.

senses.label: stay / continue to be
senses.definitionEn: to stay in the same place or condition

examples.en: Please remain in your seats until the plane stops.
examples.tr: Lütfen uçak durana kadar koltuklarınızda kalın.

examples.en: Try to remain calm, everything will be fine.
examples.tr: Sakin kalmaya çalış, her şey yoluna girecek.

examples.en: The shop will remain closed until Monday.

commonMistakesTr: "effect" isimdir; fiil olarak "etkilemek" için "affect" kullanılır.

senses.label: change caused by something
senses.definitionEn: a change that happens because of something else

examples.en: Music has a calming effect on me.
examples.tr: Müziğin üzerimde sakinleştirici bir etkisi var.
examples.noteTr: have an effect on: ...e etki etmek.

examples.en: Scientists are studying the effects of heat on crops.
examples.tr: Bilim insanları sıcaklığın ürünler üzerindeki etkilerini inceliyor.

examples.en: The new rules will take effect next month.
examples.tr: Yeni kurallar gelecek ay yürürlüğe girecek.

senses.label: helping you do something
senses.definitionEn: helping you to do or get what you want

examples.en: This app is really useful for learning new words.
examples.tr: Bu uygulama yeni kelimeler öğrenmek için gerçekten faydalı.

examples.en: Thanks, that's very useful information.
examples.tr: Teşekkürler, bu çok faydalı bir bilgi.

examples.en: A small knife is always useful when you go camping.
examples.tr: Kampa giderken küçük bir bıçak her zaman işe yarar.

senses.label: possibly
senses.definitionEn: used to say that something might be true or might happen

examples.en: Perhaps she missed the bus.
examples.noteTr: maybe ile aynı anlam, biraz daha resmî.

examples.en: Perhaps we could meet next week instead.
examples.tr: Belki onun yerine gelecek hafta buluşabiliriz.

examples.en: It was perhaps the best meal I've ever had.
examples.tr: Belki de şimdiye kadar yediğim en güzel yemekti.

commonMistakesTr: "likely" sıfattır: "He will likely come" yerine "He is likely to come" daha yaygındır.

senses.label: probably going to happen
senses.definitionEn: probably going to happen or be true

examples.en: It's likely to snow tonight.
He's the most likely person to get the job.
examples.tr: İşi alması en muhtemel kişi o.

examples.en: It's not likely that they'll arrive on time.

senses.label: completely sure
senses.definitionEn: completely sure, with no doubt

examples.en: Are you certain this is the right address?
examples.tr: Bunun doğru adres olduğundan emin misin?

examples.en: I don't know for certain when he'll be back.
examples.tr: Ne zaman döneceğini kesin olarak bilmiyorum.

examples.en: It's certain that prices will go up again.

senses.label: particular
senses.definitionEn: used to talk about a particular thing or person without saying exactly which

examples.en: The shop is only open at certain times of the year.
examples.tr: Dükkân yılın sadece belirli zamanlarında açık.

examples.en: Certain foods can make me feel sleepy.

commonMistakesTr: Kişi için "müsait" anlamında da kullanılır: "Are you available on Friday?"

senses.label: can be used or got
senses.definitionEn: able to be bought, used or reached, or free to do something

examples.en: Are you available for a quick call this afternoon?
examples.tr: Bu öğleden sonra kısa bir görüşme için müsait misin?

examples.en: Sorry, this size isn't available in blue.
examples.tr: Üzgünüm, bu beden mavi renkte mevcut değil.

examples.en: The full report is available online.

commonMistakesTr: Takım tutmak için "support" kullanılır; "I support Galatasaray" doğaldır, "I hold" değil.

senses.label: help / agree with
senses.definitionEn: to help or encourage someone, or to agree with an idea

examples.en: My parents always supported my decision to study music.
examples.tr: Ailem müzik okuma kararımı her zaman destekledi.

examples.en: Which football team do you support?
He works two jobs to support his family.
examples.tr: Ailesini geçindirmek için iki işte çalışıyor.

commonMistakesTr: Türkçedeki "katılıyorum" için "I am agree" değil, "I agree" denir.
grammarNoteTr: agree with + kişi / agree on + konu / agree to + fiil

senses.label: have the same opinion
senses.meaningTr: katılmak, aynı fikirde olmak, kabul etmek
senses.definitionEn: to have the same opinion as someone, or to say yes to something

examples.en: I agree with you, the movie was too long.
We couldn't agree on a name for the cat.
She agreed to help me with my homework.
examples.tr: Ödevimde bana yardım etmeyi kabul etti.
examples.noteTr: agree to + fiil: ... yapmayı kabul etmek.

senses.label: make or grow
senses.definitionEn: to make or grow something, especially in large amounts

examples.en: This factory produces car parts.
Turkey produces a lot of hazelnuts.
Solar panels produce electricity from sunlight.
examples.tr: Güneş panelleri güneş ışığından elektrik üretir.

senses.label: damage into pieces
senses.definitionEn: to make something separate into pieces or stop working

examples.en: Be careful not to break those glasses.
I broke my arm when I was ten.
He never breaks a promise.

commonMistakesTr: "give a decision" değil, "make a decision" denir.

senses.label: choice you make
senses.definitionEn: a choice you make after thinking about something

examples.en: It was a hard decision, but I left my job.
examples.tr: Zor bir karardı ama işimden ayrıldım.

examples.en: You need to make a decision by Friday.
examples.tr: Cumaya kadar bir karar vermen gerekiyor.

examples.en: Who made the decision to cancel the trip?
examples.tr: Geziyi iptal etme kararını kim verdi?

commonMistakesTr: Gerçekleşebilecek şeyler için "hope", gerçek dışı dilekler için "wish" kullanılır.

senses.label: want something to happen
senses.definitionEn: to want something to happen and think that it is possible

examples.en: I hope you feel better soon.
We're hoping to visit Japan next year.
examples.tr: Gelecek yıl Japonya'yı ziyaret etmeyi umuyoruz.

examples.en: Will it be sunny tomorrow? I hope so.
examples.noteTr: I hope so / I hope not: umarım öyledir / umarım değildir.

senses.label: grow / create
senses.definitionEn: to grow or change into something bigger or better, or to create something new

examples.en: Reading every day helps children develop their language skills.
examples.tr: Her gün okumak çocukların dil becerilerini geliştirmesine yardım eder.

examples.en: Our team is developing a new mobile app.
examples.tr: Ekibimiz yeni bir mobil uygulama geliştiriyor.

examples.en: The small town developed into a busy city.
examples.tr: Küçük kasaba kalabalık bir şehre dönüştü.

grammarNoteTr: receive, get kelimesinin daha resmî karşılığıdır

senses.label: get something given or sent
senses.definitionEn: to get something that someone gives or sends to you

examples.en: Did you receive my email yesterday?
She received a prize for her short story.
examples.tr: Kısa öyküsü için bir ödül aldı.

examples.en: We received hundreds of applications for the job.

grammarNoteTr: increase by + miktar / increase to + yeni değer

senses.label: become or make bigger
senses.definitionEn: to become larger in amount or number, or to make something larger

examples.en: The number of students increased by ten percent.
They're going to increase the rent again.
Exercise can increase your energy levels.

senses.label: needed
senses.definitionEn: needed in order to do or have something

examples.en: Is it necessary to book a table?
I'll stay late if necessary.
Water is necessary for all living things.

senses.label: can happen or be done
senses.definitionEn: able to happen or be done

examples.en: Please send me the file as soon as possible.
examples.tr: Lütfen dosyayı bana en kısa sürede gönder.
examples.noteTr: as soon as possible (ASAP): en kısa sürede.

examples.en: Is it possible to change my seat?
It's possible that he forgot about the meeting.

grammarNoteTr: it is difficult to + fiil; zıt anlamlı: easy

senses.label: not easy
senses.definitionEn: needing a lot of effort or skill

examples.en: The last question on the test was very difficult.
It's difficult to find a cheap flat in this city.
examples.tr: Bu şehirde ucuz bir daire bulmak zor.

examples.en: I find it difficult to wake up early in winter.
examples.noteTr: find it difficult to: ...meyi zor bulmak.

senses.label: not difficult
senses.definitionEn: not difficult; needing little effort

examples.en: This recipe is quick and easy.
The new printer is very easy to use.
Take it easy, you've worked hard all week.
examples.tr: Biraz dinlen, bütün hafta çok çalıştın.

senses.label: easy / not complicated
senses.definitionEn: easy to understand or do, or plain without extra decoration

examples.en: Can you explain it in simple words?
The answer is simple: we need more time.
examples.tr: Cevap basit: daha fazla zamana ihtiyacımız var.

examples.en: She wore a simple white dress to the party.
examples.tr: Partiye sade beyaz bir elbise giydi.

senses.label: easy to understand / see
senses.definitionEn: easy to understand, see or hear, or with nothing blocking it

examples.en: The teacher's instructions were very clear.
Is that clear, or should I explain again?
examples.tr: Anlaşıldı mı, yoksa tekrar açıklayayım mı?

examples.en: On a clear day you can see the islands from here.
examples.tr: Açık bir günde buradan adaları görebilirsin.

grammarNoteTr: have something in common: ortak noktası olmak

senses.label: happening often / shared
senses.definitionEn: happening often or found in many places, or shared by two or more people

examples.en: Headaches are very common among office workers.
examples.tr: Baş ağrısı ofis çalışanları arasında çok yaygın.

examples.en: Mehmet is a very common name in Turkey.
examples.tr: Mehmet Türkiye'de çok yaygın bir isim.

examples.en: My sister and I don't have much in common.
examples.tr: Kız kardeşimle pek ortak noktamız yok.
examples.noteTr: have in common: ortak noktası olmak.

senses.label: liked by many people
senses.definitionEn: liked or used by a lot of people

examples.en: This beach is popular with tourists in summer.
examples.tr: Bu plaj yazın turistler arasında popüler.

examples.en: Football is the most popular sport in our country.
He was never very popular at school.
examples.tr: Okulda hiçbir zaman pek sevilen biri olmadı.

senses.label: having power / force
senses.definitionEn: having a lot of physical power, or having a great effect

examples.en: He's strong enough to carry the sofa by himself.
examples.tr: Kanepeyi tek başına taşıyacak kadar güçlü.

examples.en: I like my coffee strong and black.
A strong wind knocked down several trees last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece kuvvetli bir rüzgâr birkaç ağacı devirdi.

commonMistakesTr: "weak" (zayıf, güçsüz) ile "thin" (ince, zayıf vücutlu) karıştırılmamalı.

senses.label: not strong
senses.definitionEn: not physically strong, or not having much power or effect

examples.en: I felt weak after being ill for a week.
examples.tr: Bir hafta hasta kaldıktan sonra kendimi güçsüz hissettim.

examples.en: The phone signal is very weak in the basement.
examples.tr: Bodrum katında telefon sinyali çok zayıf.

examples.en: Math has always been my weak subject.
examples.tr: Matematik her zaman zayıf dersim oldu.

grammarNoteTr: happy with + isim / happy to + fiil

senses.label: feeling good
senses.definitionEn: feeling pleased and good about something

examples.en: The kids were so happy to see the snow.
examples.tr: Çocuklar karı gördükleri için çok mutluydu.

examples.en: Are you happy with your new job?
I'm happy to help if you need anything.
examples.tr: Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa yardım etmekten memnuniyet duyarım.

senses.label: unhappy
senses.definitionEn: feeling unhappy, or making you feel unhappy

examples.en: She felt sad when her best friend moved away.
The ending of the film was really sad.
Why do you look so sad today?
examples.tr: Bugün neden bu kadar üzgün görünüyorsun?
